minutes.headline: Board heard drafts of a noise ordinance and special event permit, and a petition about Shady Point campground and Lake Shirley.
minutes.summary: The Select Board held licensing hearings, ratified police appointments, and heard the cable committee chair on a videographer policy. It discussed a draft noise ordinance, a special event permit process and a petition about Shady Point campground, all as works in progress. The town manager gave his report and a resident asked about a public gathering.

what_happened.line: The Board discussed a petition about the Shady Point campground and Lake Shirley and set it to return as a future agenda item with land use and police reports.
The Board approved the location of a new utility pole on Electric Ave as presented, the one vote in the minutes with an audible passing outcome.
Members worked through a draft special event permit, including a range of fees and waivers for nonprofits, and left it as a work in progress.
A draft noise ordinance was discussed and left as a work in progress.
Motions were made on an alcohol license change, an entertainment license, police appointments and a victualer license, but the outcomes are not audible in the recording.

why_it_matters: The noise ordinance and special event permit are drafts that could set new rules and fees for residents, events and nonprofits once adopted, so they may come back for public input.
Shady Point and Lake Shirley concerns could lead to a special permit review and enforcement changes affecting lakeside neighbors and campground use.
